name: Email Verifier (domain, MX, disposable) → dataset (Apify, publicrecords)

parameters.content:
## Email Verifier (domain, MX, disposable)
Bulk email verification at $0.0005/email ($5/10k). Checks domain, MX records and disposable domains only. It is not a mailbox or SMTP check and does not send mail.

1. Replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` in the Authorization header.
2. Edit the JSON body (`emails`) and click Test workflow.
3. Connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email if you want.

Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/email-verifier
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/email-verifier

nodes.name: Run Email Verifier (domain, MX, disposable) on Apify
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN with your Apify API token (console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Runs bill to your own Apify account at the Store price. This Actor checks domain, MX and disposable domains only — not a mailbox or SMTP check.
